stem: Which pattern of decline is observed in Delta EEG power across the brain during adolescent development?

options.text: It declines first at occipital sites and last at frontal sites.
It declines first at frontal sites and last at occipital sites.
It declines uniformly across all cortical regions simultaneously.
It only declines in the parietal and temporal lobes.

explanation: The decline in Delta power follows the same posterior-to-anterior pattern as dendritic pruning in the developing brain.
rationale: The pattern matches the sequence of dendritic pruning in brain development.

optionExplanations.A: The decline in Delta power follows the same posterior-to-anterior pattern as dendritic pruning in the developing brain.
optionExplanations.B: This reverses the actual progression; the frontal regions are typically the last to undergo these maturation changes.
optionExplanations.C: Brain development and associated sleep changes are regional and follow a specific spatial progression.
optionExplanations.D: The decline is observed across the cortex, specifically starting at the back and moving to the front.
